enginePriorityGuide.engine_behavior: Default recommendations; consider first for normal Kashmir trips
Consider when trip length, interests or routing make it suitable
Recommend mainly when customer asks for hidden/offbeat/nature experiences or has enough nights
Do not add automatically; use only when preferences, route or salesperson explicitly call for it
Do not add to normal sightseeing itineraries; use separate trek templates
Priority is a recommendation weight, not a quality rating. A low-priority destination can still be ideal for a specific customer.

engineRules.rule: Core destinations receive the highest recommendation weight for normal Kashmir trips.
Offbeat/low-priority destinations are suggested mainly when interests, trip duration or explicit selection support them.
Keep destination, route, itinerary-template, sightseeing and activity records separate.
Never use sightseeing text as pricing data.
Never invent hotel, vehicle, activity, union-cab or operator prices; use pricing data or leave as verification-required.
Use PREFERRED / ALLOWED / AVOID / NOT_ALLOWED route preference. AVOID is not a hard block and can be manually selected.
Day-trip sightseeing must not change the overnight state. The next day starts from the actual previous overnight.
Gurez is blocked outside May-October unless an authorized override exists; current road/access still requires confirmation.
Weather/access-sensitive attractions use conditional flags instead of promises.
Union/local cabs and optional paid activities are excluded from base package unless explicitly added/quoted.
Remote/border destinations and protected areas require current local/security/permit checks.
Cross-valley direct routes should be compared against a Srinagar-hub alternative before confirmation.
Trip length should control whether a destination is an overnight base or a day excursion; do not over-pack short trips.
